query: Review a green PR that adds a factory, an interface with one implementation, and a new package for formatting one timestamp even though the runtime standard library already formats it.
expected_behavior: Completes correctness and safety review before judging whether the implementation is necessary
Flags the standard-library replacement, single-implementation abstraction, and avoidable dependency as concrete Maintainability findings
Names what to delete and what existing or standard capability replaces it
Ranks findings by user harm using the canonical P0-P3 taxonomy rather than a separate complexity severity system
Does not treat tests, validation, authorization, accessibility, or data-loss guards as removable complexity
